title: Equity Accounting Note — Class H Preferred Stock Shares Bought or Retired within a Dividend Quarter
content:
On a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding whose latest entries show share activity inside the declared dividend quarter, shares earn only for the days they were held, and the dividend share basis is measured accordingly. The declared quarter runs from 1 April 2026 to 30 June 2026, 91 days.

## Rule

The dividend share basis of the holding is:

- **latest purchase and latest retirement both dated inside the declared quarter** — the quarter-end shares less that purchase times the days of the quarter before the purchase date divided by the days in the quarter, plus that retirement times the days of the quarter before the retirement date divided by the days in the quarter;
- **only the latest purchase dated inside the declared quarter** — the quarter-end shares less that purchase times the days of the quarter before the purchase date divided by the days in the quarter;
- **only the latest retirement dated inside the declared quarter** — the quarter-end shares plus that retirement times the days of the quarter before the retirement date divided by the days in the quarter;
- **otherwise** — the quarter-end shares as they stand.

## Terms used

- **Quarter-end shares**: the holding's purchases plus its reinvested dividends less its retirements, at par of 1.00 per share.
- **Latest purchase / latest retirement**: the purchase entry, and the retirement entry, with the latest effective date on the holding. A retirement entry is any entry recorded as a retirement, whatever its reason — a redemption, or a cancellation with the reason subscription cancelled.
- **Inside the declared quarter**: dated on or after 1 April 2026 and on or before 30 June 2026.
- **Days of the quarter before a date**: counted from the quarter's first day, inclusive, to that date, exclusive. The days in the quarter are 91.
- The basis is carried unrounded.

## Condition table

| Latest purchase inside the quarter | Latest retirement inside the quarter | Dividend share basis |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Quarter-end shares less the purchase share, plus the retirement share |
| Yes | No | Quarter-end shares less the purchase share |
| No | Yes | Quarter-end shares plus the retirement share |
| No | No | Quarter-end shares |

## Worked figures (hypothetical holding with 61,400.00 quarter-end shares)

| Activity on the holding | Days before the date | Dividend share basis |
|---|---|---|
| Latest purchase USD 10,000.00 dated 16 May 2026; latest retirement dated in 2025 | 45 | 61,400.00 less 10,000.00 times 45 over 91 (4,945.05…) gives 56,454.95… |
| Latest retirement USD 5,000.00 dated 1 June 2026; latest purchase dated in 2025 | 61 | 61,400.00 plus 5,000.00 times 61 over 91 (3,351.65…) gives 64,751.65… |
| Both of the above | 45 and 61 | 61,400.00 less 4,945.05… plus 3,351.65… gives 59,806.59… |
| Latest purchase dated 1 April 2026 | 0 | 61,400.00 (no day before the first day) |
| Latest purchase dated 31 March 2026 | — | 61,400.00 (not inside the quarter) |
